rationale: Describes streaming data collection, standardization of cross-channel data, identity linking into a unified customer profile, and correlated breakdowns. These are conventional data integration and analytics functions. No predictive, learned or AI mechanism is described; 'without writing SQL statements' is a query-interface claim.
evidence_spans: Streaming data collection offers up-to-the-minute customer views and behaviors.
IDs from multiple channels and devices are connected into a single, unified customer profile.
Fully correlated data gives you unlimited breakdowns of any data element across any channel without writing SQL statements.
